insights.name: CLSCulprits
insights.text:
## Insight Title: Layout shift culprits

## Insight Summary:
Cumulative Layout Shifts (CLS) is a measure of the largest burst of layout shifts for every unexpected layout shift that occurs during the lifecycle of a page. This is a Core Web Vital and the thresholds for categorizing a score are:
- Good: 0.1 or less
- Needs improvement: more than 0.1 and less than or equal to 0.25
- Bad: over 0.25

## Detailed analysis:
The worst layout shift cluster was the cluster that started at 3,861 ms and ended at 4,861 ms, with a duration of 1,000 ms.
The score for this cluster is 0.3563.

Layout shifts in this cluster:
### Layout shift 1:
- Impacted elements:
  - VIDEO class='video-stream html5-main-video'

- Start time: 3,861 ms
- Score: 0.3563
- No potential root causes identified

## Estimated savings: none

## External resources:
- https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cls-culprit
- https://web.dev/articles/cls
- https://web.dev/articles/optimize-cls

insights.name: ForcedReflow
insights.text:
## Insight Title: Forced reflow

## Insight Summary:
This insight identifies forced synchronous layouts (also known as forced reflows) and layout thrashing caused by JavaScript accessing layout properties at suboptimal points in time.

## Detailed analysis:
A forced reflow occurs when JavaScript queries geometric properties (such as `offsetWidth`) after styles have been invalidated by a change to the DOM state. This can result in poor performance. Learn more about [forced reflows](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/forced-reflow) and possible mitigations.

The forced reflow checks revealed one or more problems.

The following is the top function call that caused forced reflow(s):

 - check @ https://ftp-cdn.mitiendanube.com/forked-files/007/400/935/installations/14828608/static/js/featured-collection-a3c03f55d53014612d213148512387d2.js:141:19

Total reflow time: 12 ms

Call frames that trigger reflow (including total time):

 - 0.6 ms in t @ https://ftp-cdn.mitiendanube.com/forked-files/007/400/935/installations/14828608/static/js/libraries-standalone-59fa5e7833de73d735795f6c8e66eede.js:5:3557
 - 11 ms in l @ https://nsk-cdn-static.tiendanube.com/vanilla-adapter-0.39.0.min.js:25:26401
 - 12 ms in check @ https://ftp-cdn.mitiendanube.com/forked-files/007/400/935/installations/14828608/static/js/featured-collection-a3c03f55d53014612d213148512387d2.js:141:34
 - 3 ms in render @ https://rhino-performance.com/:17803:20
 - 4 ms in setupMore @ https://rhino-performance.com/:17755:20
 - 0.4 ms in updateArrows @ https://rhino-performance.com/:17765:19

## Estimated savings: none

## External resources:

insights.name: LCPBreakdown
insights.text:
## Insight Title: LCP breakdown

## Insight Summary:
This insight is used to analyze the time spent that contributed to the final LCP time and identify which of the 4 subparts (or 2 if there was no LCP resource) are contributing most to the delay in rendering the LCP element.

## Detailed analysis:
The Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) time for this navigation was 286 ms.
The LCP element (IMG class='image-priority-high video-block-image', nodeId: 26) is an image fetched from https://img.youtube.com/vi_webp/we6rl2Q8AxI/maxresdefault.webp (eventKey: s-1341, ts: 15045127534).
## LCP resource network request: https://img.youtube.com/vi_webp/we6rl2Q8AxI/maxresdefault.webp
eventKey: s-1341
Timings:
- Queued at: 103 ms
- Request sent at: 124 ms
- Download complete at: 133 ms
- Main thread processing completed at: 147 ms
Durations:
- Download time: 9 ms
- Main thread processing time: 13 ms
- Total duration: 43 ms
Initiator: https://rhino-performance.com/
Redirects: no redirects
Status code: 200
MIME Type: image/webp
Protocol: h2
Priority: High
Render-blocking: No
From a service worker: No
Initiators (root request to the request that directly loaded this one): https://rhino-performance.com/
Response headers
- expires: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 21:28:26 GMT
- content-type: image/webp
- cache-control: public, max-age=7200
- content-length: <redacted>

We can break this time down into the 4 subparts that combine to make the LCP time:

- Time to first byte: 64 ms (22.4% of total LCP time)
- Resource load delay: 39 ms (13.7% of total LCP time)
- Resource load duration: 30 ms (10.5% of total LCP time)
- Element render delay: 153 ms (53.4% of total LCP time)

## Estimated savings: none

## External resources:
- https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/lcp-breakdown
- https://web.dev/articles/lcp
- https://web.dev/articles/optimize-lcp

No checkout, purchases, submissions, private accounts or populated cart.
Read-only blocks POST, including some noncommercial app/analytics/media reads.
PSI conditions partially unknown; Chrome157 vs local155. No cross-source regression claim.

No before/after implementation; all changes remain proposed.
